Claude 2026-09-02: .testimonial-frame-wrap is framed media, not a text container. It wraps a Google Forms iframe, and the site's established pattern for framed media (.photo-frame) is that the frame owns the border and the media fills it flush. An inset here would show an ivory band around the form's white ground and read as a mismatch. No text of ours is near the boundary.
